ai_analysis.summary: Runtime package renders a browser-DOM phonics activity titled 'Phonics Detectives / Digraph Detectives'. Startup passed with no errors, all listed assets loaded, no blocked external requests, and an interactive DOM with category tabs, answer tiles, audio and help controls. The current view shows a single digraph prompt ('sock' -> 'ck') but no gameplay actions were replayed. Source-analysis artifacts exist for main.js and two remote scripts via webcrack, while 'editable_project_verified' is false and Cocos/build validation is explicitly out of scope. Therefore this is evidence of a bootable UI shell, not proof of a fully verified educational game.

editable_logic.boundary: Only the shipped files in the runtime package are observable editable surfaces. The bundled game logic lives mainly in main.js and rosebud-game-defaults.js/css; remote _remote/ scripts are delivered as opaque hashed payloads.
editable_items: main.js (game state, tab routing, prompt/answer wiring)
read_only_or_external: _remote/*.js hashed modules (ScriptsLoader-Universal.js, ChatManager.js, ProgressLogger.js, ImageGenerator.js, OGP.js)
Remote .woff2 font delivered from hashed path
Browser storage APIs are observable but not guaranteed persistent across deployments
editable_logic.secondary_development_boundary: A derivative can safely replace main.js, default CSS/JS, and local assets; can patch index.html to change entrypoints; can wrap or stub localStorage/sessionStorage. It cannot reliably modify the internal behavior of hashed remote modules unless they are replaced with same-path equivalents and the loader hash/integrity checks (if any) are updated. Rebuilding as a Cocos/Unity-style project requires editor/build validation not present here.

Engine core files (cocos-js/cc.fde70.js, src/system.bundle.6de80.js, src/chunks/bundle.27815.js, application.6c455.js) are minified/obfuscated and should be treated as binary runtime dependencies. Native media (png/mp3) can be replaced but do not contain gameplay logic. The blocked remote-data endpoint can be stubbed or mirrored locally, but this does not prove gameplay balance is preserved.

ai_analysis.summary: Cocos2d-js (Cocos Creator 2.x) web build. Startup reached the main scene; observed a title screen with Chinese text '吃豆子' and a '开始游戏' button. No runtime JS errors, no missing assets, no external network calls, and storage is isolated/empty. A mini-game SDK patch neutralizes ad/login/reward behavior for localhost. No gameplay loop was exercised, so completeness is not proven.

editable_logic.boundaries: Logic is bundled/minified in cocos2d-js-min.e0461.js and import JSONs; scene graphs and asset UUIDs are machine-generated. Direct source editing requires Cocos Creator project or JS deobfuscation. CSS and host-specific SDK patches can be edited without rebuilding the engine.

game_profile.core_gameplay: 操控吃豆人在迷宫中沿道路移动，吃掉全部豆子并躲避或利用道具反制鬼魂敌人，达成通关或耗尽生命后结算。
game_profile.core_experience: 经典街机式吃豆子体验，强调即时反应、路径规划与风险躲避。
game_profile.controls: 键盘方向键（或虚拟摇杆）控制移动方向；设置面板可调整音乐、音效、移动速度。

game_profile.progression: 通过 localStorage 的 'pac' 键记录已通关数，通关后递增并加载下一关（代码中 mod 10 循环）；设置项持久化到 localStorage。
game_profile.save: 本地 localStorage 加密存储（XXTEA 算法，键前缀 10192_），保存设置（音乐、音效、速度、音量）与关卡进度；本次已验证设置项在刷新后保留。

ai_analysis.summary: Partial inventory of a Cocos Creator 2.x HTML5 web build. It contains a minified Cocos2d-JS runtime (cocos2d-js-min.40b98.js), bootstrap/setting scripts (main.0f99b.js, src/settings.801e6.js), mobile CSS, and several asset bundles: internal, main, resources, bundleMap_1/2/3, and bundleAudios. Assets are stored by UUID under each bundle's import/ and native/ folders, with JSON metadata + PNG/JPG/MP3 resources. A single remote asset is referenced at _remote/91d4a19849c304ed/landscape.gif. No source project, no index.html, and no runtime logs are present in the provided material, so this is only a packaging/portability evidence review.

easily_editable: src/settings.801e6.js (launch config, bundle registration, device flags)
Bundle config.json files (assets/*/config.*.json) for bundle names, versions, and asset lists
Bundle import/*.json metadata (UUID, type, dependencies, native file references)
Native assets (PNG/JPG/MP3/GIF) can be replaced if UUID metadata references are updated consistently
hard_to_edit: main.0f99b.js and all bundle index.*.js are minified/obfuscated; source-level logic changes require deobfuscation/patching
cocos2d-js-min.40b98.js is the engine runtime; should be treated as read-only unless replacing the entire engine version
editable_logic.notes: Game logic is likely compiled into the minified index.js files inside each bundle. Secondary development is therefore limited to asset swapping, config tuning, and byte-level JS patching; behavioral changes require reverse-engineering or a rebuilt project.

portable_modules.bundle_strategy: Map and audio bundles are split, supporting on-demand loading; portable if the host keeps relative paths and serves bundle configs correctly.

dependencies.browser_apis: Canvas/WebGL, AudioContext/HTMLAudio, touch/mouse events, localStorage (typical Cocos settings)
dependencies.external_asset: _remote/91d4a19849c304ed/landscape.gif must be reachable at runtime (network or mirrored path)
dependencies.path_dependencies: UUID-based folder structure and config.*.json/index.*.js must remain paired and relative paths unchanged
no_evidence_of: obvious third-party analytics or SDK files (cannot confirm absence from inventory alone)

No real runtime testing has been performed
No deobfuscated source, so no behavioral assertions are possible
No version/build metadata to identify Cocos Creator exact version
verification_limits.boundary: This is a runtime web package, not an editable source project. Any secondary development must work within the compiled bundle structure and minified scripts.

game_profile.category: 阵容策略 / 自动战斗 / 关卡闯关
game_profile.perspective: 侧视战斗，竖屏布局；卡通角色在森林场景中从两侧交战。
game_profile.core_gameplay: 玩家选择上阵英雄，开始战斗后由角色自动移动和攻击，通过伤害与血量变化决定胜负。胜利领取金币并解锁下一关。
game_profile.core_experience: 战前选择队伍，战中通过角色动作、攻击效果、伤害数字和血条获得直观反馈，战后通过关卡推进获得明确目标。操作负担较低，当前两名可用角色提供有限的阵容选择。
game_profile.controls: 鼠标点击或触屏点击。点击地图骷髅进入布阵，点击英雄切换上阵状态，点击开始战斗；胜利后点击空白返回地图，再点击骷髅继续。
game_profile.game_loop: 进入地图 → 选择关卡 → 配置队伍 → 自动战斗 → 胜利结算 → 返回地图 → 进入下一关。五关完成后战役结束。失败不推进关卡，可再次挑战。 可在英雄页消耗金币升级。
game_profile.content: 2名初始角色（101和401），最多5个队伍槽位；5个关卡，每关1波敌人。敌方使用角色101，生命、物理及魔法伤害、防御的基础属性倍率依次为0.55、0.65、0.75、0.85、0.95。
game_profile.progression: 每关100金币，共500；金币升级英雄至5级，费用100/150/200/250，基础生命/伤害/防御每级加20%。无离线收益。
game_profile.save: 在当前浏览器保存金币与关卡进度，刷新后恢复，不跨设备同步。整段战役重开需清理该游戏的浏览器存档；没有游戏内重置入口。

game_profile.category: 竖屏出租车调度解谜游戏
game_profile.core_gameplay: 点击前方畅通的车辆驶出停车场，让同色乘客进入有限候车车位中的车辆；受阻车辆无法驶出。
game_profile.core_experience: 在倒计时和有限车位约束下安排车辆出场顺序。
game_profile.controls: 触点点击车辆；界面提供地图、静音、设置，以及带广告占位流程的撤销和增加车位。
game_profile.game_loop: 选择车辆、驶入车位、匹配乘客、车辆满载离场；超时可失败并重试。胜利结算路径有源码定义，尚未实测。
game_profile.content: 已实测第一关；地图显示市中心与海港节点。源码定义按关卡编号生成布局、颜色和目标，后续关卡可玩性未验证。
game_profile.progression: 源码在正常关卡胜利时更新等级、徽章和金币；本轮未实测通关解锁。
game_profile.save: 源码使用 localStorage 键 taxiSortCityRush.v1；静音状态已实测刷新恢复，关卡胜利进度的刷新恢复未验证。

ai_analysis.summary: The package is a Construct 3 HTML5 browser export of a fish/shark-themed arcade game (inferred from jaws_*, fish*, explosion*, and aquatic background assets). The runtime starts successfully in an isolated browser replica: one canvas, WebGL 2 / SwiftShader rendering, no missing external requests, no uncaught startup errors, and default IndexedDB entries for musicOnOff/soundOnOff only. A mini-game-sdk patch is applied that explicitly fails rewarded ads on localhost and avoids fake login/rewards. Only the startup phase has been observed; no gameplay, input, audio, ad mediation, progression, or monetization paths have been exercised.
ai_analysis.secondary_dev_boundary: This is a compiled Construct 3 deployment artifact, not an editable source project. Secondary development is therefore bounded to: (1) DOM/UI changes through style.css, (2) host/initialization configuration and ad adapter logic in config.js / ad.js, (3) service-worker and offline behavior in register-sw.js / offlineclient.js, (4) asset replacement (images/*.png, media/*) provided sheet layouts, file names, and audio formats stay compatible, and (5) adding external JS hooks around the runtime. Core gameplay logic lives inside minified c3runtime.js and generated data.json / scripts/project/scriptsInEvents.js; meaningful rule changes require the original .c3p project or re-export from Construct 3. Hand-editing data.json or the runtime is unsupported and likely to corrupt the project.

runtime_hooks: External adapter code injected around c3runtime.js; not runtime internals
project_scripts: scripts/project/scriptsInEvents.js are generated/minified; editable only through Construct 3 re-export

dependencies: Modern browser with WebGL 2 support (Canvas 2D fallback may exist but not verified)
Construct 3 runtime engine and the exact plugin/behavior set encoded in data.json
Service Worker capable HTTPS or localhost origin with correct scope
Audio codecs: Ogg Vorbis, WebM audio, AAC/M4A depending on target platform
localStorage and IndexedDB for settings and save-like storage

Touch and/or keyboard input for the observed touchareaP1/P2 and implied versus controls
verification_limits: Only the startup phase was observed (~9.6 s); replay_action_count is 0 and no user interactions were performed.
WebGL rendering used SwiftShader, producing ReadPixels GPU-stall warnings; performance is not representative of target hardware.
IndexedDB snapshot contains only default musicOnOff/soundOnOff values; no progression, score, unlock, or cross-store atomicity can be verified.
Rewarded ads are patched to explicitly fail on localhost; no real ad network or mediation flow has been validated.
No gameplay assertions can be made: movement, collision, AI, scoring, level loading, game-over, versus mode, and audio playback are unverified.
Core code is minified/compiled; direct security or logic audit is not possible without the original .c3p source or a deobfuscation effort.
No external network requests were observed during startup, but dynamic requests may occur after gameplay starts.
next_checks: Gameplay smoke test: start game, control shark/fish, trigger eat/collision, score, and game-over states.
Input verification for both P1 and P2 touch areas and any keyboard/watch unlock inputs.
Audio playback verification on target devices, including codec fallback paths.
End-to-end ad integration test with real mediation SDK after removing or configuring the localhost patch.
Real-device GPU profiling and input latency measurement; investigate SwiftShader ReadPixels stalls.
Save/load and progression persistence across sessions, including cross-store consistency.
Asset completeness and license clearance for all fish, shark, explosion, background, and music assets.
Diff against a clean Construct 3 export from the source .c3p to confirm no unauthorized runtime modifications.
PWA manifest, icons, service-worker scope, and offline cache behavior.
Security/CSP and iframe integration tests if deployed inside a mini-game platform.
Versus mode validation if the versusmode.ogg asset indicates a two-player mode.

game_profile.core_gameplay: 使用方向键控制小鱼在海底场景中移动，寻找并吃掉体型更小的鱼以增长体型/得分，同时躲避体型更大的鱼和地雷等危险。
game_profile.core_experience: 街机式生存成长：单局尽可能存活并获得更高分数。
game_profile.controls: 键盘方向键控制移动（上下左右），鼠标/触摸点击用于菜单选择。
game_profile.game_loop: 开始游戏→在海底游动觅食→吃掉小鱼成长→碰到大鱼或地雷死亡→GAME OVER 结算 BEST/LAST 分数和金币→可重开或返回菜单。
game_profile.content: 基础海底场景、多种尺寸 AI 鱼、金币气泡、地雷；广告、皮肤/角色选择、每日奖励、多人模式等代码存在，但未在本轮中逐一验证。
game_profile.progression: 单局获得分数与金币；最高分(fisheat_highscore)和金币(fisheat_gold)持久化到 IndexedDB 并在重开/刷新后读取。
game_profile.save: 通过 Construct 3 LocalStorage 插件使用浏览器 IndexedDB 保存，键包括 fisheat_highscore、fisheat_gold、musicOnOff、soundOnOff 等；本轮验证刷新后最高分可恢复。

data.reason: 本轮沿已保存草稿继续验证，未再修改源码或广告逻辑。基于修复后的公共截图链路，实机画面已能正常显示第1关球杆试用新手引导：球台、白球、目标球、球杆、瞄准辅助线、底部方向滑动条及右侧道具面板均渲染正确。在竖屏 390×844 下对底部方向滑动条执行多次水平拖拽，滑动条上的手指图标产生明显位移，证明触摸输入被游戏真实接收并产生可观察反馈，满足“新手引导需至少一次真实操作有可观察反馈”的验证要求。此前刷新实验已观察到 localStorage 中 user1/other1 内容在 reload 前后发生变化且跨会话保持，说明游戏正在使用本地存储进行存档读写。runtime 未报告任何外部 HTTP 请求，广告初始化错误 `r is not defined` 已被 local-host.js 中的 StageBannerMgr 离线补丁屏蔽，未阻断场景启动与引导流程。本轮验证终点为新手引导（tutorial），未推进到正式击球/进洞/结算的 gameplay 闭环，因此未覆盖的后续关卡、商城、PVP、排行榜、完整物理反馈等不纳入本次闭合范围。

report.summary: 本轮沿已保存草稿继续验证，未再修改源码或广告逻辑。基于修复后的公共截图链路，实机画面已能正常显示第1关球杆试用新手引导：球台、白球、目标球、球杆、瞄准辅助线、底部方向滑动条及右侧道具面板均渲染正确。在竖屏 390×844 下对底部方向滑动条执行多次水平拖拽，滑动条上的手指图标产生明显位移，证明触摸输入被游戏真实接收并产生可观察反馈，满足“新手引导需至少一次真实操作有可观察反馈”的验证要求。此前刷新实验已观察到 localStorage 中 user1/other1 内容在 reload 前后发生变化且跨会话保持，说明游戏正在使用本地存储进行存档读写。runtime 未报告任何外部 HTTP 请求，广告初始化错误 `r is not defined` 已被 local-host.js 中的 StageBannerMgr 离线补丁屏蔽，未阻断场景启动与引导流程。本轮验证终点为新手引导（tutorial），未推进到正式击球/进洞/结算的 gameplay 闭环，因此未覆盖的后续关卡、商城、PVP、排行榜、完整物理反馈等不纳入本次闭合范围。

dependency_updates.reason: 原引擎与原游戏包已采集并离线启动；local-host.js 中的 StageBannerMgr 离线补丁已屏蔽 `r is not defined` 启动错误。
新手引导场景及所需资源已实际加载并正常渲染；未游玩关卡与商城资源不在本次验证范围。
第1关/新手引导配置已生效：level_node 显示“1”，动态场景 game_newbie 正确实例化。
已验证的新手引导流程未产生外部 HTTP 请求；存档读写使用 localStorage 并在 reload 后保持。结算、广告奖励、排行榜等后端接口未在此流程触发，对当前验证终点不适用。
本地引擎启动通过；MINI_GAME_SDK 本地适配已提供必要存根，广告不伪造奖励。

ai_analysis.summary: 本包为 Defold HTML5/WASM 构建的 fish_eat_fish 在 Poki 离线场景下的运行包。证据包括：引擎 wasm、JS glue（fish_eat_fish_wasm.js）、Defold 档案（archive/*.arci/arcd/dmanifest/game0.projectc）、加载图、dmloader.js 以及一份 IndexedDB 缓存的资源 zip。poki-offline patch 将原 Poki SDK 拒绝分支改为可离线继续，runtime 报告 loading-finished 且无致命错误。但同时出现 PokiSDK.measure/captureError 未实现警告，商业广告/奖励事件标记为 unavailable，auds.poki.io 配置请求与 leveldata.poki.io ping 被拦截。当前验证仅限于加载阶段完成，未覆盖实际玩法、输入响应、渲染帧、音频、存档持久化或真实 Poki 域名部署，因此不能声称完整验收。

ai_analysis.summary: The package is a Cocos Creator browser build with a patched mini-game SDK. Runtime startup succeeded in a controlled browser environment (one canvas, WebGL initialized, no script errors during boot), but no gameplay assertions were recorded. Source decompilation was limited to three scripts and did not verify an editable Cocos project. The current evidence supports 'boots to engine initialization' only, not full functional acceptance.
ai_analysis.editable_logic: Secondary development is bounded by the compiled output form. User-modifiable without engine rebuild: CSS overrides (style.css), asset manifest JSONs under assets/main and assets/resources, loose image/audio assets, and the local-host SDK patch behavior. Not directly editable in this package: bundled JavaScript logic in index.b957e.js, src/chunks/bundle.js, cocos-js/cc.js, and generated .bin asset payloads; changing these requires the original Cocos project or a full rebuild. The mini-game-sdk patch must remain explicit-failure only; adding fake ad rewards or login success would cross the declared boundary and is not supported by the evidence.

Main asset bundle (assets/main/config + index + imported JSON/scene/prefab files)

Patched mini-game SDK adapter for local-host rewarded ads (explicit-fail mode)
Canvas/WebGL bootstrap layer and style.css viewport configuration
dependencies: Browser with WebGL 1.0 and listed extensions
Cocos Creator import-map and SystemJS module resolution
Integrity of assets/main/config.b957e.json and assets/resources/config.b1179.json for bundle discovery

Original source project and Cocos editor toolchain for any logic-level modification
verification_limits: Only startup phase observed (~33 s); no user actions, level transitions, input, audio, or reward flows were exercised

Do not treat this as a complete, validated source project.

ai_analysis.summary: 当前运行时包可启动并显示标题界面（罗马尼亚语文本“Bine ai venit la fermă!”），未观察到实际种植/浇水/收获等玩法；资源文件（作物、动物、工具图标及地块）和 main.js、manifest.json、远程加载器均已提供；index.html 存在一次已知补丁；localStorage 中有一个名为 ferma_save_final 的存档条目，但存档内容未返回；无外部网络依赖请求，运行时未报错。由于缺少可玩性验证，不能视为完整验收。
ai_analysis.editable_logic: source_analysis 显示 main.js 和远程 ScriptsLoader-Universal.js 已通过 webcrack 生成静态副本，但 editable_project_verified 为 false，说明尚未还原为可二次开发的项目结构。index.html 的补丁哈希（before/after）已知，但补丁内容未给出，可能改动了引擎初始化、画布尺寸或脚本加载顺序。远程加载器可能负责注入后续脚本或配置，是二次开发的边界点：若该加载器在运行时才拉取逻辑，则仅修改本地 main.js 不一定生效。当前可编辑范围暂定为本地 manifest、可直接替换的 WebP/PNG 资源以及已解出的 main.js 源码，但若要使用 Cocos/Phaser 等引擎构建流程，需要原始工程文件和构建验证。
dependencies: 浏览器标准环境（HTML5 Canvas、JavaScript）
软件 WebGL 回退渲染
localStorage 用于存档读写
无运行时必需的外部网络资源
verification_limits: 仅验证了启动阶段（startup），未执行任何交互/回放动作
没有实际玩法断言，不能声称完整验收
localStorage 只返回键名和哈希，未返回存档正文
index.html 补丁仅提供 before/after 哈希，未提供内容差异
source_analysis 为静态副本，未验证可在编辑器中重新构建
运行时域名为 replica-runtime.invalid，不代表真实部署环境
next_checks: 获取并审查 index.html 补丁的具体内容，确认对引擎初始化的影响
对 main.js 及远程加载器进行反编译/源码阅读，定位游戏主循环和状态机
通过自动化交互测试验证种植、浇水、收获、商店、任务等核心玩法
读取并解析 ferma_save_final 存档结构，验证存档/读档功能
映射所有可能的动态脚本/网络请求，确认远程加载器是否会拉取额外资源
在目标平台（桌面浏览器/移动端 WebView）上复测，验证触摸与性能
确认素材授权与本地化（EN/RO 切换）机制
尝试用对应引擎（如 Cocos Creator/Phaser）打开并重新打包，验证 editable_project

attempts.error: timed out
attempts.diagnosis: 本轮实际截图几乎全白/空白，与 converted/evidence/runtime.json 中声称 Home 场景已渲染并通过的状态矛盾；当前步骤报 TimeoutError，说明离线运行时游戏要么未真正完成首屏渲染，要么在初始化阶段阻塞。入口 HTML 显示游戏依赖外部 17yoo SDK（https://c.17yoo.cn/sdknew/main.js）以及本地 gdAd.js，离线环境中这些脚本会 404 或阻塞，可能导致 Cocos 启动流程挂起或画面空白。需要定位源码中对 SDK/广告的调用点，确认是否因为缺失宿主接口导致启动分支异常。
attempts.hypothesis: ['H1: 17yoo SDK 离线 404 导致 window.MINI_GAME_SDK 未初始化，后续 gdAd.js 或游戏主逻辑访问 undefined 抛出异常，Cocos 渲染停止在空白帧。', 'H2: gdAd.js 中广告初始化逻辑依赖 SDK，失败后进入死等或错误分支，阻塞 boot。', 'H3: 主 bundle 中某些平台判断逻辑（platform/app/web）在离线环境下走了错误分支，导致场景加载完成但画面未绘制。', 'H4: 当前空白截图是超时前瞬间的启动画面/白屏，实际逻辑可能仍卡在资源加载或脚本执行。']

evidence.detail: 入口在 body 末尾加载 https://c.17yoo.cn/sdknew/main.js 与 ./gdAd.js，并设置 window.MINI_GAME_SDK_INFO；离线运行时这两个脚本必然缺失/失败。
JSON 报告 passed:true 且检测到 Home 场景节点，但实际截图空白，说明节点树存在不等于画面正确渲染；可能是历史成功快照或检测阈值问题。
实际验证截图几乎为纯白/空白，仅底部有轻微渐变，未见 Home UI 元素。

game_profile.controls: 鼠标按住或拖动、WASD及方向键移动；Space消耗炸弹；Shift在能量充满时发动 Blast Charge；P或Escape切换暂停/恢复；标题支持点击或按键启动。输入说明来自实际界面与源码，全部按键和能力效果未逐项实测。

game_profile.content: 实际画面包含星空、玩家飞船、小行星、弹体和战斗HUD；配置及指南还描述拦截机、无人机、轰炸机、精英、母舰炮塔、蛇形首领与核心突破终战。后续内容未实测，不据配置推定已完成关卡数。

ai_analysis.summary: A Flash game (hunl2zw.swf) packaged with Ruffle nightly 2024-05-31 (ruffle.js, core JS, WASM). Two patches redirect the portal loading UI to a standalone local player and enforce a local-only resource policy. The runtime reports loaded=true and playerState=2 with no runtime errors, missing assets, external requests, or blocked navigation. However, canvasCount=0, buttons/labels arrays are empty, and no replay actions were performed. WebGL INVALID_ENUM warnings appear but do not stop initialization. This is evidence of successful engine/ asset startup, not proof of playable gameplay.

can_edit: index.html host wrapper and Ruffle player configuration (autoplay, scale, wmode, quality, base URL, context menu, allowNetworking)
loader/branding UI that replaces the original portal frame
local-content policy filters (what local files may be loaded, analytics/tracking removal)
file paths and packaging layout as long as relative references remain valid
isolated storage scope settings and service-worker behavior
SWF replacement only by overwriting hunl2zw.swf with a binary-compatible asset
cannot_edit_without_reverse_engineering: original hunl2zw.swf internal ActionScript, symbols, or timeline logic
editable_logic.secondary_development_boundary: The current package is a wrapper-level port. Modification must stay within the host page, config, local policy, and asset substitution. Recompiling the emulator core or altering SWF internals is outside the licensed/verified boundary. The game must continue to load local-only resources and must not be repackaged as a different title.

dependencies: Browser or runtime with WebAssembly and WebGL 2 support
Ruffle nightly 2024-05-31 build matching the bundled JS/WASM
Correct MIME types for .wasm (application/wasm) and .swf (application/x-shockwave-flash or application/octet-stream)
Local file or static HTTP origin (origin spoofed as https://replica-runtime.invalid in the observed runtime)
Optional: localStorage/sessionStorage permission if the SWF uses SharedObject
No observed external dependencies; original analytics/ads/nav portals are explicitly excluded by local-content policy
verification_limits: Runtime 'passed' only confirms the engine initialized and the SWF reached playerState=2; it does not confirm interactive gameplay
canvasCount=0 and empty buttons/labels arrays mean no HTML-level interactive elements were detected; this may be an instrumentation gap or the SWF stage may not be exposed as a <canvas> element
Only one startup screenshot is referenced; no post-intro, menu, in-game, or save/load screenshots
No replay actions were executed, so input response, scoring, progression, and win/loss states are unverified
WebGL INVALID_ENUM warnings indicate the wgpu-webgl renderer may differ from native Flash/Adobe player rendering
Storage snapshot is read-only and isolated; it cannot prove that game progress loads or persists correctly
The index.html hash changed, but the actual patch diff is not provided, so the exact host behavior cannot be audited
Runtime origin is a synthetic invalid URL; results may not transfer to a real deployment domain
next_checks: Execute scripted replay actions (keyboard/mouse) and assert visible state changes or score/level changes
Capture screenshots beyond startup: title screen, main menu, first interactive frame, and after a save/load cycle
Inspect SWF metadata (dimensions, ActionScript version, frame rate, symbols) and compare file hash to a known original
Verify whether canvasCount=0 is a measurement bug by checking the actual DOM for Ruffle's stage container
Test audio playback and mute behavior
Test local save/load by writing a SharedObject/localStorage value and reloading the page
Run with browser devtools network logging to confirm zero external requests under local-content policy
Review the exact index.html patch diff to ensure no unintended redirects or scripts were added
Test on multiple browsers/operating systems to validate WebGL compatibility and input handling
Profile frame timing to ensure the WebGL warnings do not cause stalls during gameplay
